source.permittedUse: Internal transcription evidence for the InnoCalc concrete-reinforcement-rate module.
caution: The workbook is a quantity calculator. It has no pass or fail cell, no utilisation and
no design check, so there is nothing of that kind to reproduce.
The saved state has an EMPTY reinforcement schedule, so Rate!C17 (total weight) and
Rate!C18 (rate) both cache zero. The published evidence is therefore the member
geometry chain only: Rate!G11, G12, G14, G15, G16 and G17.
The schedule row arithmetic is asserted separately by cases whose inputs are chosen
here rather than taken from the workbook, and those cases are marked as derived.
